Hi Liz —

Great talking earlier. Per our conversation I attached an initial private-offer draft (DataRiver_PrivateOffer_Draft_v1.pdf) and a short co-sell checklist so you can share with procurement. Quick summary of the ask:

- DataRiver wants a private offer for the 3-node inference pilot (expected monthly usage ~200k tokens).
- You're asking whether we can match a 12-month term for AWS co-sell parity, and how buyer approval gating will work on your side.

Two questions I wanted to confirm before I loop legal/finance:
1) Do you need a 12-month minimum to be eligible for your internal co-sell program, or would a 6-month pilot + automatic renewal be acceptable?
2) Who (title/email) signs on the buyer side for private offers in your org? If procurement needs an evidence pack (SOC2, data retention, audit logs) we can provide a pdf stub with links.

Next steps: if you confirm term/approver I’ll send an updated private-offer draft and open a DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin

Marcus —

Looping Soojin from Partner Ops since AWS co-sell eligibility is the variable here. Short notes:

- AWS partner co-sell historically requires a minimum 12-month commitment for a paid private offer to count toward co-sell incentives. Exceptions exist but need Partner Ops approval and justification.
- For AWS to accept the private offer into their co-sell pipeline we need the offer to include: 12-month term (no staged opt-out), activation PO from buyer, and the evidence pack they requested (SOC2 + product security questionnaire).
- If DataRiver insists on starting as a 6-month pilot we can structure a 6-month prepaid with a 12-month automatic conversion, but that often complicates procurement signoff.

Soojin — can you confirm whether Partner Ops can approve a 12-month requirement waiver if we document the customer go-to-market plan (joint webinar + co-marketing commitment)? Attaching our internal co-sell checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: CoSell_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 10:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot private offer: term parity & co-sell path for DataRiver

Vanessa / Marcus —

Short answer: partner ops can approve an exception, but we need a documented GTM commitment and an internal business case. Requirements:

1) 12-month term in the private offer (AWS will not count shorter lengths for co-sell unless signed off).
2) Customer PO and Finance approver (Ana Ruiz) documented with email chain; procurement must be able to confirm ability to pay within their system (payment terms OK).
3) Evidence pack: SOC 2 Type II (pdf link), security questionnaire (completed), and network isolation notes.
4) Co-sell readiness: a one-pager with joint activities (webinar date, single-slide partner play, assigned SDR for co-sell).

If Marcus can secure a written commitment for 12 months + the GTM one-pager, I’ll submit a waiver request to AWS Partner Ops to see if we can fast-track partner incentives. I attached the internal waiver template.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partner Ops
Redwood Inference
